verdict.rationale: Apify's own Actors accept a list of start URLs (e.g. apify/web-scraper's startUrls array), the Python client has asyncio support, and webhooks can fire when a run finishes, so the product does provide batch scraping with async-style orchestration. Nothing documents scale to thousands of URLs or a non-blocking batch-run pattern; the cited convenience call actually waits for the run to finish. missing for 10: documented scale to thousands of URLs per batch, explicit fire-and-forget async run-start semantics, throughput/concurrency limits, independent hands-on corroboration of large batch jobs.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can batch scrape thousands of URLs asynchronously

citations.quote: you can use webhooks to start another Actor when an Actor run finishes or fails.
